title: 'Third Street Blues', his composition
summary: He introduces his original blues with Tyree Glenn; it is played.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I've another suggestion. We've heard you play, we've heard you sing with and without accompaniment. We've listen to you talk and now I think we ought to listen to something that you composed. (LAUGHTER). We'll have you do everything but act. (LAUGHTER).

'Third Street Blues' One of my favorite musicians is on this record. Tyree Glenn, a great trombonist and a great, great person. And the personnel of the band is pretty good. I think Peanuts Hucko is on clarinet, George Wettling on drums. And it's just a blues I composed. You had to have a couple of original numbers to put on the record date you know on the date. And anyway, you'll get a chance to hear Tyree Glenn on this number called 'Third Street Blues' which is just a little blues that I....
Well I'll be happy to hear Tyree Glenn because I know what a marvellous musician he is. And I'm also going to be happy to hear your composition too. (LAUGHTER).
That rounds out your ecleticism for today. (LAUGHTER).
